events.continuity_hook: Checks the Kansas City plan shortly before travel after flights and lodging were chosen.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck the updated flight timing, outline the simplest airport transfer and host-pickup sequence, note any hotel room requests to send ahead, and decide whether to leave the bookings unchanged.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Kansas City visit, the airline posts a modest outbound time change and the host sends final lobby pickup instructions for Thursday morning. Current constraints are keeping the no-car plan workable, preserving enough Wednesday evening margin for check-in and dinner, making the Thursday pickup without an early rideshare, and keeping the Friday after-lunch return intact. The unresolved issue is whether the held flight and downtown/Crossroads hotel still give enough buffer or need a small adjustment.

events.continuity_hook: Starts the next fall professional-trip episode after the Kansas City site visit is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact comparison of flight and hotel pairings with total estimated cost, arrival and return timing, meeting access, airport transfer choices, breakfast details, room basics, and nearby dinner options.
events.scenario_brief: After the Kansas City visit wraps, Marisol starts planning an October 14-16 Minneapolis board retreat with a Wednesday evening welcome dinner, Thursday board sessions at a riverfront arts center, and a Friday committee wrap expected to finish before lunch. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, deciding between the board hotel block and lower nearby hotels, avoiding a rental car, keeping the lodging total easy to explain, and returning Friday after lunch without getting home late. No bookings exist, and the main unresolved issue is whether the block hotel convenience outweighs a cheaper stay that includes breakfast.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Minneapolis lodging after the board meeting location and block deadline become firm.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two hotel choices by total cost, walking time, breakfast value, room amenities, cancellation terms, and nearby dinner access, then recommend which refundable reservation to hold.
events.scenario_brief: The board office confirms that Thursday early packet pickup and both board sessions will be at the riverfront arts center, while the negotiated hotel block is attached by an indoor walkway and expires in two days. Current constraints are avoiding a cold morning walk with meeting papers, keeping lodging cost defensible, finding an easy Wednesday dinner, and checking breakfast plus in-room coffee and mini-fridge details. The unresolved choice is whether to hold the block hotel or a refundable limited-service hotel twelve minutes away that includes breakfast.

events.continuity_hook: Moves from the Minneapolis hotel hold to final airfare timing once the Friday agenda settles.
events.interaction_goal: Refresh viable Chicago-Minneapolis round trips, compare fare, travel time, airport margin, and Chicago arrival time, then identify the itinerary to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol has held the Minneapolis block hotel, and the Friday committee wrap is now set for 11:15 a.m. to noon with lunch nearby likely until about 1:00. Current constraints are reaching Minneapolis Wednesday in time for a 5:00 p.m. welcome dinner, allowing time for hotel bag drop, departing Friday only after lunch, and avoiding a late Chicago arrival. The unresolved choice is between a cleaner United nonstop pair and a cheaper later return on another carrier that lengthens the trip home.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new late-fall grant-site visit after the October board trip is finished.
events.interaction_goal: Create a flight, hotel, and local-transport comparison with estimated totals, arrival and return timing, likely rideshares or rental-car cost, breakfast details, room basics, and a recommendation on whether skipping a rental car is practical.
events.scenario_brief: After the Minneapolis board retreat, Marisol begins planning a November 4-6 Raleigh-Durham grant-site visit with a Thursday morning creative-aging program in Durham, a Thursday afternoon archive education meeting in Raleigh, and a Friday debrief near Research Triangle Park expected to end around noon. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, deciding whether a rental car is worth it, keeping lodging close to the travel rate, and returning after lunch Friday. No bookings exist, and the main unresolved question is which hotel area best balances the spread-out site locations with airport access.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Raleigh-Durham lodging after pickup and Friday debrief locations become firm.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the downtown Durham and RTP hotel options after tax and likely local transportation, show the Thursday and Friday timing differences, list room and cancellation details to confirm, and recommend the lower-friction reservation.
events.scenario_brief: The Triangle host clarifies that Thursday morning pickup can only be from downtown Durham and moves the Friday debrief to an RTP office from 10:00 a.m. to noon, while a Wednesday dinner with the project director is now planned near downtown Durham. Current constraints are avoiding a rental car if the rideshare plan remains reasonable, staying within the lodging cap, having dinner within an easy walk after arrival, and checking breakfast plus in-room coffee and refrigerator details. The unresolved choice is between a downtown Durham limited-service hotel near pickup and a cheaper RTP property that would add more transportation.
